meta.name: prompt-refiner
meta.description: Improve prompts before sending them to get better results. Use when you want to refine a task description.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化提示词以获得更精准的AI输出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常写提示词但结果不理想，需要改进提问方式。
copy.tagline_en: Refine prompts for better AI responses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write prompts but get unsatisfactory results and need to improve your queries.

howto.what: 装上后，当你提出任务时，Claude 会先分析你的提示词是否清晰、有背景、有约束，然后给出改进版本并解释原因。
howto.when: 当你要求优化或改进一段提示词时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化这个提示词：写一篇关于AI的文章。
say.note: Claude 会分析并给出更清晰、具体的版本。

say.text: 改进我的任务描述：设计一个登录页面。
say.note: Claude 会补充背景、约束和格式要求。

howto.what_en: When you have a task, Claude will analyze your prompt for clarity, context, constraints, and examples, then suggest an improved version with explanations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to refine or improve a prompt or task description.

say_en.text: Help me refine this prompt: Write an article about AI.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and provide a clearer version.

say_en.text: Improve my task description: Design a login page.
say_en.note: Claude will add context, constraints, and format.
